examples.description: Calibrate Binoculars thresholds on a labeled manifest

inputs.target: a JSONL manifest with ai_status labels

purpose: Operator-side Binoculars threshold calibration. Runs binoculars_audit over a labeled manifest, derives empirical threshold-low and threshold-high values by ROC analysis at a target FPR and TPR, and writes a calibration report. The framework default thresholds stay unset; the output is the operator's own calibration.
